Community Partner Events

Stewart’s Caring Place is honored to have several partner events that are thoughtfully hosted by local organizations, families and individuals each year. The proceeds from these events help us continue our mission of offering programs and services at no cost to individuals and families.

Interested in hosting an event on our behalf?  Contact us Today!

Holding Light, a free art exhibition featuring the work of Dee Fairweather, Megan Frankenfield, and Care Hanson. Their work will be on display from July through September, 2026 and can be viewed 9am-5pm M-F at Stewart’s Caring Place 3501 Ridge Park Dr. Akron 44333

“Holding Light” is a group exhibition that celebrates the transformative power of art to nurture, restore, and connect. Through distinct yet complementary artistic practices, the artists explore themes of resilience, growth, memory, and the enduring presence of hope. Rich textures, luminous color, and evocative imagery encourage viewers to slow down, reflect, and find moments of beauty amid life’s complexities.   The exhibition’s title, Holding Light, speaks to the ways we carry hope, strength, and compassion through times of challenge and change. It also reflects the mission of Stewart’s Caring Place, where support, connection, and healing are offered to individuals and families facing cancer.

Curated by ART x LOVE.
